name: Miro (RealtimeBoard, Inc.)
what: Online visual-collaboration whiteboard platform (now marketed as an AI workspace) for distributed teams.
homonym_note: Google News hits for 'Miro' include the Victoria Miro gallery, Joan Miró and the MIRO rescue charity; unrelated.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026) and on the archived visionaries.vc/portfolio page from 2023; TechCrunch (2022-09-22) lists Miro among the companies Visionaries Club had invested in. No round announcement names Visionaries.
membership.quote: It's so far invested in companies such as Personio, Miro, Choco

funding_rounds.lead: ICONIQ Growth (co-led per the ICONIQ sibling)

status.event: Definitive agreement (2026-09-10) for Bending Spoons to acquire 100% of Miro at an enterprise value of $1.355B (equity value ~ $1.79B), all cash; expected to close in Q4 2026, not closed as of 2026-09-30

valuation.quote: this implies an equity value of approximately $1.79 billion

notes: Entry undetermined: Visionaries is named in neither the Series B release (SiliconANGLE 2020-04-23: 'led by ICONIQ Capital and included Accel and a number of individual investors'; Pulse 2.0 the same) nor the Series C release (TCV's copy, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2022-05: investors 'ICONIQ Growth, Accel, Atlassian, Dragoneer, GIC, Salesforce Ventures, and TCV' plus named angels; 'post-money valuation of $17.5B'). The firm counted Miro as a portfolio company by Sept 2022, so the position dates from 2020-2022 and is probably a secondary or an unlisted allocation, possibly via one of the single-company Late Growth SPVs (2021-); no filing ties an SPV to Miro (RealtimeBoard is a US company, so no German register). WebSearch ('"Visionaries Club" Miro investment round') returned only vendor profiles and a summary line about a 'December 2019 pre-emptive financing round alongside Atomico' that no source ties to Miro (Atomico is not a Miro investor), so it is not used. Valuation: the signed sale price (equity value ~$1.79B) is the latest priced event, recorded as kind 'tender' because it is an agreed acquisition price, not a primary round; last primary was the $17.5B Series C post-money (Jan 2022). Aligns with the Accel, ICONIQ and TCV siblings (private at the agreed price until close). HQ: San Francisco as in the ICONIQ/TCV siblings (SiliconANGLE lists San Francisco first among its offices; the company names no HQ); the Accel sibling's NL country reads the Amsterdam hub. Focus SaaS as all siblings.
